popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Ovid ends his song with Augustus guarding earth while Venus stars Julius Caesar — the princeps as the last metamorphosis' living half.

popCulture.title: Aeneid
popCulture.creator: Virgil
popCulture.description: Virgil's epic prophesies Augustus' peace — the Julian heir as destiny's answer to Troy's fall.

popCulture.title: Augustus
popCulture.description: Rome's first emperor — Caesar's heir whose comet-backed legitimacy Ovid and Virgil made mythic.

popCulture.title: Caesar's Comet
popCulture.description: The sidus Iulium Augustus claimed as his father's soul — celestial propaganda that closes Ovid's Metamorphoses.
